rules.directive: Keep English vocabulary accessible for 12th-grade Indian graduates from non-English medium backgrounds. Prefer 'simple, everyday words' over academic jargon.
rules.source_failure: Initial pilots used words like 'parametric', 'dichotomy', and 'stochastic' which disengaged beginners.

rules.directive: Anchor RAG in the 'Open-Book Exam vs Closed-Book Exam' analogy. It instantly clicks with Indian students who understand exam pressure.
rules.source_failure: Abstract software architecture diagrams failed comprehension tests without a physical analogy.

rules.directive: Explicitly state that RAG DOES NOT retrain the AI model or change its internal weights; it simply feeds reference notes into the prompt.
rules.source_failure: Frequent beginner confusion assuming RAG is fine-tuning or training new models.

rules.directive: Never use terms like 'Embeddings' or 'Vector DB' without first demystifying them as 'Search Numbers' or 'Library Catalog Cards'.
rules.source_failure: Unexplained AI buzzwords caused high drop-off in reader comprehension checks.

rules.directive:
Guardrail against failure in 'AUDIENCE_VOCABULARY_AND_TONE': - [AUDIENCE_VOCABULARY_AND_TONE] Replace all research jargon with simple, everyday 12th-grade English. Use short sentences (under 20 words).
- [RELATABLE_ANALOGY] Use an everyday Indian life analogy, such as an Open-Book Examination vs Closed-Book Exam or a school library.
- [NO_UNEXPLAINED_JARGON] Do not mention HNSW or tensor dimensions. Focus strictly on Retrieval (Search), Augment (Attach), Generate (Answer).
- [COHERENT_TEACHING_FLOW] Replace quiz with an intuitive scenario-based question (e.g. college WhatsApp admission bot or exam notes).

rules.directive:
Guardrail against failure in 'ACCURACY_AND_GROUNDING': - [ACCURACY_AND_GROUNDING] Correct the factual error: Clarify that RAG never touches the AI's internal model weights. It only looks up reference text and feeds it as a prompt.
- [RELATABLE_ANALOGY] Use an Open-Book exam analogy: you don't grow a new brain, you simply look at your notebook.
- [NO_UNEXPLAINED_JARGON] Remove backpropagation and gradient descent; explain that the AI model remains frozen.
- [CORE_PILLARS_COVERAGE] Explain the 3 real pillars: Retrieve (search), Augment (attach), Generate (synthesize).
- [COHERENT_TEACHING_FLOW] Update quiz to test understanding of the search-and-attach mechanism.
rules.source_failure: - [ACCURACY_AND_GROUNDING] Fatal technical error: RAG explicitly does NOT retrain or fine-tune neural model weights at query time. It inject
